title: Boost Run: Event Feed
premise: A neon-styled community chat hub hosts a featured arcade run where the player launches a short car chase to collect 10 energy cores before crashing out.
interaction_model: Login-and-menu navigation with click/tap UI, then direct left/right steering in a four-lane canvas runner using arrow keys or touch halves of the screen.
objective: Collect 10 energy cores during a run while avoiding barriers and surviving with three health points.
progression: The player signs in, opens the boost-run channel, launches the run, survives an increasingly fast lane sequence, then returns to the chat feed with a reward unlocked after winning.
theme: Futuristic neon arcade racing wrapped in a social event-feed presentation.
mood: Energetic, sleek, playful, and lightly competitive.
likely_audience: Casual players who enjoy short mobile-friendly arcade runners, simple reflex challenges, and flashy sci-fi UI presentation.
confidence_notes: High confidence in the lane-based runner structure, collectible target, and chat-wrapper meta presentation. Moderate confidence in whether to frame it more as a driving game or a runner, since the mechanics are runner-like but the avatar is a car.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished single-screen browser game called "Boost Run" framed as a futuristic community event feed. Start with a login card where the player enters a pilot tag, then reveal a Discord-like sci-fi chat interface with channels such as boost-run, pit-chat, and race-briefs. In the main featured channel, show a launch card for a live event run with a progress bar and a button to start the challenge. When launched, open a centered arcade overlay containing a tall mobile-shaped canvas. The core gameplay should be a four-lane endless-style runner viewed from above, where the player controls a glowing futuristic car and steers only left and right using arrow keys on desktop or tapping the left/right halves of the screen on mobile. Continuously scroll the road downward, gradually increase speed, spawn collectible energy cores and dangerous barriers in random lanes, give the player 3 health, and add brief invulnerability after collisions. The objective is to collect 10 energy cores before losing all health. Include a HUD for cores collected and remaining lives, arcade sound effects for start, pickup, crash, fail, and victory, plus flashy visual feedback for crashes and wins. On failure, show a retry-ready briefing screen; on success, show a celebratory completion screen and let the player claim a reward that updates the original chat feed to indicate the event has been cleared. Keep the tone neon, energetic, and casual, with glossy sci-fi panels, responsive layout behavior, and a lightweight social-hub fantasy around the arcade run.
